result.title: Optimized Car Damage Detection Using CNN and Object Detection Model
result.summary: Car damage detection systems play a vital role in scenarios, like the insurance claims process, accident reporting systems, or a documented write-up of the various damages a vehicle in a car garage exhibits upon entry and exit. This paper presents a two-fold model architecture encompassing a convolutional neural network used to classify the collected input samples as clear or damaged, thereby filtering out the undamaged images, before the input is passed on to the object detection layer for further localization and classification of defects into Scratch, Dent, Glass Shatter, and Smash. A deviation from the focus of related work, this paper poses the use of unified models while applying transfer learning techniques to augment performance that caters to multiple use cases. The design of this model has been made to optimize performance by incorporating the two models to streamline the processing of input samples. The model boasts significant performance with accuracies of 98% for the CNN layer and 0.5 mAP for the object detection layer. However, the metric for the object detection layer seems to understate its performance due to reasons discussed within the paper.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向车损检测场景，先用 CNN 将输入图像分为完好或受损以过滤无关图片，再交由目标检测层定位并分类划痕、凹陷、玻璃碎裂等缺陷，并结合迁移学习报告分类准确率与 mAP。
